egress.terms: free direct GET over HTTPS, plain text, no metering.

tooling: plain TCP: `nc termbin.com 9999` returns the URL on the socket. Works with any netcat, and with bash /dev/tcp where nc is absent (used for the probes here).
chaining: unlimited pastes x ~1 MB. Its distinguishing property is that it needs no HTTP client and no TLS — a raw TCP sink. Useful as an out-of-band manifest/credential store, useless as a bulk tier.
limits_note: ~1 MB per paste; no expiry documented; no delete path; no listing.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: approx. 1 MB per paste, no account, no count limit. Measured: 1,000,000 bytes stored and retrievable; 2,400,000 bytes -> connection reset. Oversize inp

reliability_note: Oversize input is dropped by resetting the connection mid-write, not by an error message — the client sees 'Connection reset by peer' and any partial data is lost. Random 4-5 char slugs, so URLs are guessable.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'echo just testing! | nc termbin.com 9999' -> 'https://termbin.com/test'; returns a URL on the socket
probe: 1,000,000-byte payload -> , GET bytes=1000000; 2,400,000-byte payload -> cat: write error: Connection reset by peer
